Q: Netsuite Suitetalk API request "current role does not have permission" error A:

I've just solved the same problem and the solution you suggested on Oct 13th does not seem to be the fix. I tried many changes one by one, reverting each change if it did not fix the issue, and found that the one change that solved this was adding the following permission to my integration's role: Reports > SuiteAnalytics Workbook

I would be curious to know if you maybe changed a few things and also turned on this permission and if perhaps that was the fix? I ask for the benefit of future generations in case this discussion might be the solution for someone down the line.
